relations.statement: For each n, the predicate c -> M0 halts from initCfg0 (pair (encode c) n) is not a ComputablePred on codes c.
relations.hypotheses: Mathlib ComputablePred.halting_problem is assumed; reduction from the halting problem via initCfg0.

lemmas.statement: For every n, the predicate fun c => M0 halts from initCfg0 (pair (encode c) n) is not ComputablePred.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem l_halting_not_computable (n : ℕ) : ¬ ComputablePred (fun c : ToPartrec.Code => True) := by sorry

near_misses.claim: For a fixed code c, halting of M0 from initCfg0 (pair (encode c) n) is not decidable, as a predicate in n.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The target quantifies over the code c for fixed n. A single instance is a Boolean fact, so it is trivially computable, and the varying parameter matters.

open_obligations: Exact signature of initCfg0 and halting_not_computable not given in @SRC, so the lemma skeleton is a placeholder and not the real statement.
The reduction from ComputablePred.halting_problem to M0 halting through the TM2->TM1->TM0 chain is not grounded.
